long_biography.plain_text:
Herbert Kloiber gave the Cleveland Orchestra the manuscript of Mahler’s Second Symphony in 2020. He had bought the work at auction and supported the orchestra for years. A long-serving trustee, he has also chaired its European advisory board. A performance by the Cleveland Orchestra Youth Orchestra at St Florian helped him decide on the manuscript’s permanent home.

Classical music also shaped the Austrian media entrepreneur’s production work. Through Clasart Classic, which he founded in 1976, he recorded performances by artists including Glenn Gould and Vladimir Horowitz. The company’s work with the Cleveland Orchestra included Bruckner and Brahms, while its cinema broadcasts brought Metropolitan Opera productions to audiences in Germany and Austria.
